records.gloss: Give thanks to YHWH, for [he is] good, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.
pieces: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.

L.1: Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.

R.1: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good! His faithful love lasts forever.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: Every one of the 26 verses ends with the same words (ki le'olam chasdo), "for his loyal love [is] forever": the people's answer to each line. The refrain is rendered the same way in every verse at each level.

decisions.choice: a call heard throughout Israel's worship
decisions.reason: The opening line and the refrain are also 106:1, 107:1 and 118:1, and were sung at the ark's coming to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 16:34), at the temple's dedication (2 Chronicles 7:3) and at the laying of the second temple's foundation (Ezra 3:11).

decisions.choice: a litany of God's acts
decisions.reason: The psalm gives thanks for creation (verses 4-9), the exodus (10-16), the gift of the land (17-22) and God's care now (23-25). Later Jewish tradition calls it the Great Hallel. It retells what 135:8-12 tells more briefly.

decisions.choice: Thank
decisions.reason: Readable says "thank" in the call that runs through the psalm (verses 1-3, 26).

decisions.choice: the Sea of Reeds: the sea Israel crossed, known as the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The name (yam suf) means "sea of reeds". It is the sea of the crossing (Exodus 15:4, 22). The ancient Greek translation calls it the Red Sea, the name long used for it.

decisions.choice: cut into pieces: split in two
decisions.reason: The verb (gazar) is to cut, and the noun (gezarim) is the pieces: the sea was divided (Exodus 14:21). The same noun is used of the halves of the animals in God's covenant with Abraham (Genesis 15:17).

decisions.choice: the Red Sea

records.source: שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: who in our low state remembered us, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.
pieces: who remembered us when we were brought low, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.

L.23: who in our low state remembered us, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.

R.23: He remembered us when we were weak and helpless. His faithful love lasts forever.

decisions.choice: us: the singers' own story
decisions.reason: The psalm turns from the past to the singers themselves: the God of the exodus has also helped them.

decisions.choice: our low state: when we were humbled
decisions.reason: The word (shefel) means lowness, a humbled state. It may point to defeat and exile, or to any time of weakness.

decisions.choice: remembered: took action for us
decisions.reason: When God remembers, he acts for those he remembers (Genesis 8:1; Exodus 2:24).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

records.source: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: and he tore us away from our foes, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.
pieces: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tore us free from our enemies, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.

L.24: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} snatched us away from our foes, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.

R.24: He pulled us away from our enemies. His faithful love lasts forever.

decisions.choice: tore us away: rescued by force
decisions.reason: The verb (paraq) is to tear off or pull away, as prey from a beast's jaws (Lamentations 5:8).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

records.source: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: giving food to all flesh, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.
pieces: who gives food to every living creature, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.

L.25: giving food to all flesh, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.

R.25: He gives food to every living thing. His faithful love lasts forever.

decisions.choice: all flesh: every living creature
decisions.reason: "All flesh" is every creature that lives, people and animals.

decisions.choice: God feeds all he has made
decisions.reason: The God who rescued Israel also feeds all his creatures every day (104:27-28; 145:15-16).

decisions.choice: who gives
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a participle; Balanced makes it a clause.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

records.source: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: Give thanks to [the] God of the heavens, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.
pieces: Give thanks to the God of heaven, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.

L.26: Give thanks to the God of the heavens, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.

R.26: Thank the God of heaven. His faithful love lasts forever.

decisions.choice: the God of heaven: the God who rules from heaven
decisions.reason: This title ('El hashamayim) is found only here in the Psalms. The same title, with another word for God, is common in Ezra and Nehemiah (Ezra 1:2; Nehemiah 1:4). The psalm ends where it began, with the call to give thanks.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.
